data.description: 【莱万汀 · 熔岩工坊】滚烫热浪翻涌的重型武器铸造车间内，莱万汀靠在炽热的合金铁砧旁，单手握着大剑剑柄，剑尖深深刺入熔铁地面激起漫天火花。她抹去额头上的汗珠——「这把剑的动力过载模块刚刚升级完毕，手感棒极了！下次出击，我要冲在先锋队的最前头！」
data.promptProse: Laevatain leans beside the hot alloy anvil, gripping her greatsword with its point driven into the forge floor as she wipes sweat from her forehead. Her ignited layered black-and-pink combat outfit moves amid flame and orbiting embers. The medium view places the anvil across the foreground and workshop machinery behind. Forge fire lights her gloves and sword core, throwing sharp orange reflections along the metal edges.
data.title: 莱万汀 · 熔岩工坊
